question: Express the system $x+y-z=2$, $2x-y+3z=6$ and $x+2y+z=5$ in the form $AX=B$. Hence, verify whether $X=\begin{bmatrix}2\\1\\1\end{bmatrix}$ is its solution.
explanation:
Matrix representation
The coefficient, variable and constant matrices are $$A=\begin{bmatrix}1&1&-1\\2&-1&3\\1&2&1\end{bmatrix},\quad X=\begin{bmatrix}x\\y\\z\end{bmatrix},\quad B=\begin{bmatrix}2\\6\\5\end{bmatrix}$$ Therefore, the system is $AX=B$.
Substitution of the proposed solution
For $X=\begin{bmatrix}2\\1\\1\end{bmatrix}$, $$AX=\begin{bmatrix}1&1&-1\\2&-1&3\\1&2&1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}2\\1\\1\end{bmatrix}$$
Matrix multiplication
Thus, $$AX=\begin{bmatrix}2+1-1\\4-1+3\\2+2+1\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}2\\6\\5\end{bmatrix}=B$$
Verification
Hence, the proposed matrix $X$ is a solution of the system.
